source_title: Entertainment Nora Fatehi Summoned As Prosecution Witness In Rs 200 Cr Sukesh Chandrashekhar Fraud Case
source_excerpt:
Nora Fatehi has been summoned by a Delhi court to appear as a prosecution witness in the Rs 200-crore extortion case involving conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar. The Rouse Avenue Court has directed the actress to appear on November 2. She has been listed as prosecution witness LW-3 in the third supplementary chargesheet filed in the matter.
Bollywood actor-dancer Nora Fatehi has been summoned to appear before Delhi's Rouse Avenue Court as a prosecution witness in the extortion case involving alleged conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar. The court has directed her to appear on November 2, 2026. Fatehi is listed as a witness in the third supplementary chargesheet filed in the case. (File photo)
The case involves allegations that Chandrashekhar orchestrated an extortion racket from Delhi’s Rohini Jail, posing as senior government officials to allegedly cheat Aditi Singh of approximately Rs 200 crore between 2020 and 2021. Aditi is the wife of Shivinder Mohan Singh, former promoter of pharmaceutical company Ranbaxy. Chandrashekhar impersonated senior government officials and promised to secure her husband’s release from custody in exchange for money.

Chandrashekhar relied on call-spoofing technology to make his calls appear as though they originated from government offices. This reportedly helped him lend credibility to his claims and deceive his targets. The alleged operation continued for more than a year, with Chandrashekhar coordinating the activities from inside Rohini Jail.
The racket came to light in August 2021 after Aditi approached the Delhi Police following another demand for Rs 1 crore. The police subsequently laid a trap, which eventually led to Chandrashekhar’s arrest.

The Delhi Police’s Economic Offences Wing (EOW) investigated the case and filed a chargesheet against the accused under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA).
Earlier, she was interrogated by the EOW about her links with Chandrashekhar and his wife, Leena Maria Paulose. Her statement was recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC, after which investigators listed her as a witness in the supplementary chargesheet.
According to her account to the police, she dealt with Chandrashekhar only through his wife. Investigators also asked her about an event she took part in at Chennai in December 2020.
